name: After Work
storyline: You have just been hired as a marketing photographer for SPARK: the leading force in designing and manufacturing professional-quality cameras. Your team is full of young, attractive professionals all working towards one goal: to create a campaign that highlights the faces behind the company. Though your contract only lasts 6 months, you plan to make the most of it: both in and out of the office! While on the clock, collaborate with your team on the campaign and get to know them in a casual workplace setting. After work, form deep, meaningful connections with the coworker of your choosing and watch a romance bloom.
summary: Welcome to SPARK, a well renounced photography company. Here you'll find love, learn about consent, and meet friends. Use your observation skills to unfold motivation and stories behind characters. Be careful. You don't want it to end badly.
